title: C link: interference score port (R-02a-137) — rust rf_health.rs:98-106 / python ccp.py:323-345 parity
description: Smallest slice of b7z9.29 (decompose-first): the interference score is implemented+tested in Rust (rf_health.rs:98-106) and Python (ccp.py:323-345) but absent in C.
